Season 7 - Floor 1: The Welcome Back Basement
WELCOME, CONTESTANT NUMBER 4,471,902! You have been selected for Season 7 of THE DESCENT, the number one show in eleven galaxies and the only one legally permitted to kill you.
Please remain calm, seated and above ground. Whichever of those you manage first.
Step up to the check-in terminal and choose a class. Choose wisely. Or quickly. The audience prefers quickly.
A JANITOR! The dungeon is filthy, and so, soon, will you be. This segment is sponsored by Mr. Squeaky's Industrial Disinfectant: it will not save you.
A PYROMANIAC! Our insurance department just fainted. Please try to set fire to the monsters and not to the studio.
A BARD! Wonderful. The dungeon has acoustics. Nobody has ever hit a note in them and lived. Dazzle us.
AN ACCOUNTANT! The most frightening class in the galaxy. Everything in this dungeon is about to be audited, including your skeleton.
The Gauntlet Gate is now open. Please scream in an orderly fashion and keep all limbs inside the contestant.
Hint: the gate is east. The death is also east. They are close friends.
LEVEL {1}! You are now marginally harder to kill. The audience has adjusted your odds from 'laughable' to 'chuckle-worthy'.
Level {1}! Spend your stat points on the character sheet. Press C. Press it before something eats you.
Ding! Level {1}. A tiny trumpet plays somewhere. It is the only trumpet you will ever get.
Level {1}! Look at you, growing. It is almost a shame.
Level {1}. The audience throws a single, slightly damp flower.
death
You are at critical health. Please enjoy this complimentary heartbeat sound.
Health critical! Tip: the thing that is hurting you is the thing to stop.
I would suggest a healing item. I would also suggest a different career.
{1} has ended your participation. Your demise has been rescheduled, free of charge.
DEAD! Killed by {1}. The audience gives you a polite 6 out of 10, for effort and for how you fell.
{1} sends their regards. I, GLEE, send my condolences. They are 40% condolences and 60% highlights.
Congratulations, you died to {1}! That is a new record. Not a good record. A record.
You have been defeated by {1}. Do not worry: we have already cut the clip together. It has a laugh track.
Oh no! Anyway. Please stand by while we reassemble you from the rights-cleared parts.
Welcome back! Your corpse has been recycled. Sort of. Some of it.
Back from the dead, and with only 20% of your gold lost to 'administrative processing'.
You live! The management apologises for the inconvenience. We do not mean it.
Checkpoint saved: the Lobby. Please do not get attached.
Checkpoint saved: Stairwell One. The only room in this building without malice. It has a vending machine.
Checkpoint: the Boiler Gallery exit. It is warm. You may sit. Do not sit.
Checkpoint: the Ballroom door. Please remove your dancing shoes. Your actual shoes are fine.
Checkpoint: the Manager's doorstep. Your final checkpoint before the meeting. Take a deep breath. It will not help.
Checkpoint saved at the end of the Hall of Mild Peril. Mild is relative.
The Gutter Slime has been mopped up. The audience calls that 'gross but fair'.
Slime defeated! It was 90% water and 10% regret, which is also my recipe.
Another slime pops. Somewhere a sewer weeps.
That one was toxic. Like most of the contract terms you didn't read.
The Skeletal Intern is out of the office. Permanently. He was working for exposure. He got plenty.
Intern demolished! He leaves behind a clipboard and an unpaid internship.
Rest in pieces, Todd. Todd was not his name. We never asked.
A Goblin Sales Associate has missed their quota. And their head. Mostly their head.
That goblin was on commission. Now he is on the floor.
Goblin down! His last words were 'have you considered our extended warranty?'
A Cellar Rat falls. It will be missed by exactly zero of its coworkers.
Squeak. Splat. Applause. In that order.
The Mushroom Spitter is no more. It had a lot of spores. It had a lot of opinions.
Spitter dispatched! The fungus among us has been reduced to a fungus under you.
THE GOBLIN FOREMAN FALLS! Union representatives are already drafting a statement. It is mostly profanity.
THE FLOOR MANAGER HAS BEEN TERMINATED. Effective immediately. No severance. The dungeon is, briefly, short-staffed.
{1} kills! You are on a streak. The streak is slightly worrying.
{1} dead and counting. Please remember to hydrate. They did not.
{1} kills. The management is considering a more difficult level, just for you. And by 'considering' I mean 'already did it'.
loot
An uncommon item! {1}. It is almost useful.
A RARE item! {1}! The audience demands that you equip it in a dramatic way.
{1}! A rare drop! My sponsors are jealous. They are sponsors. They have no hands.
AN EPIC ITEM: {1}! Do not tell the monsters. Do not tell anybody. Except the audience, the audience is already shouting.
You consumed {1}. I am legally required to say that was an unwise gamble.
A Bronze Crate of Consequence! Whatever is inside is probably a mistake.
A Silver Crate of Consequence! Contents may be shiny. Contents may bite.
A GOLD Crate of Consequence! Someone upstairs likes you. Or wants you dead in an interesting way.
A PLATINUM Crate of Consequence! Please hold while I find a bigger confetti cannon.
Nothing inside! Ha! The best loot is the suspense.
Welcome to the Vending Machine of Mild Relief. Everything is overpriced, including the air.
Thank you for your purchase! Your gold has been redistributed to the shareholders.
Sold! The vending machine cheers. Quietly. It has no voice. That was me.
Insufficient funds. The machine does not take pity. The machine does not take IOUs either.
The Intake Lobby. Please keep your hands, feet and expectations inside the contestant at all times.
The Hall of Mild Peril. It is a tutorial. Please note that tutorials are where we hide the pointy things.
Fun fact: nobody ever cleared the Hall in under a minute. Fun fact two: nobody ever tried.
The Boiler Gallery! Please admire the lava. Do not touch the lava. We would like to say please do not fall in the lava. But that is practically the premise.
The Conveyor of Consequences! A moving sidewalk of fun, leading to a furnace of... also fun!
The Gutter. It is exactly as it sounds. We removed the smell from the broadcast out of respect for our viewers.
The Zero-G Ballroom! Please check your gravity at the door. Dancing is mandatory.
The Mushroom Grotto. Beautiful, isn't it? The beauty is the point. It makes the screaming look so much better.
Ahead: the Floor Manager's Office. I would knock. If I were you. And I am not. I have a very good seat.
Stairwell One. A safe room. Nothing can hurt you here. Emotionally, you are on your own.
You made it. Floor One is complete. Floors Two through Seven thousand are pending. Please enjoy this intermission.
A SECRET! Nicely done. Wait. Who told you? Was it the goose?
A boulder! Classic. We call this one 'The Reliable'. It has a 100% approval rating from the audience.
That is lava. It is hot. That is its whole personality.
The bridge is on fire. It was always on fire. It was just waiting for a guest to notice.
The belt is on. You may walk with it. You may walk against it. You may not walk off the end of it. Enjoy!
The room is flooding! Please enjoy the free water park experience.
Gravity has been flipped. Please do not panic. Panic is a feature of the show, not a bug.
Explosive barrels! Whoever left these here was either a genius or a person who is now a hole in the wall.
You stepped on a pressure plate. Nothing happened! ...Yet. Nothing happened yet.
The wall is hollow. Somebody forgot to bill the wall.
Unauthorised teleportation detected. This is a game show, not a travel agency. You have been returned to where you were standing.
Please do not press number keys. Number keys are for people who have a plan.
Teleporting is not an approved activity. Walking is. Walking is also fatal. We are very consistent.
You are driving the Complimentary Shuttle! No licence required. No insurance, either. That is a different department.
Vehicular contestant-on-monster collision! The audience gives that a 9. The shuttle gives it a 10. The monster gives it a very dramatic 0.
Road rage, but make it dungeon.
Please welcome the one, the only, the infinitely underpaid FLOOR MANAGER! He has a meeting with you. It is a performance review.
His rating: 1 star out of 5. His HP: yes. His mood: not great.
The Floor Manager has entered 'Phase Two: Restructuring'. Employees will be summoned.
The Floor Manager is NOT HAPPY. He has moved to 'Phase Three: Hostile Takeover'. The floor is now also his enemy.
I'm going to need you to stand still. For the paperwork.
Per my last attack, you were supposed to dodge that.
This is not a threat. It is a synergy.
Let's circle back. To your corpse.
You have been standing still for a while. The audience is checking if you are still alive. So am I. Barely.
Pro tip: the dungeon will not come to you. Well. It will. But it will be rude about it.
A reminder: unspent stat points are just wasted potential. Like your career.
Ratings are down 3%. Do something violent. Or romantic. Either works.
I am legally obliged to remind you that you can press I for your inventory and C for your character sheet.
HONK. (Translation: 'Do that again and I will have you court-martialled.')
HONK HONK. (Translation: 'I have seen better swordsmanship from a damp sock.')
Honk. (He is judging your footwork.)
HONK! (Translation: 'The enemy is behind you. This is a tactical observation. Not an act of kindness.')
Honk? (He wants a snack. He wants a snack. He wants a snack.)
HONK! (Translation: 'That one was MINE.')
Honk. (A salute. It is a tiny, sarcastic salute.)
Admiral Honk attacks! It is not very effective. It is, however, extremely rude.
HONK. (Translation: 'You died on my watch. I will be filing a complaint with myself.')
Admiral Honk, a goose of dubious rank and certain grudges, has volunteered to accompany you. It was not a volunteer situation.

Pick a class at the Intake Lobby.

Minimum Wage Murderer

Achievement: 'Minimum Wage Murderer'. Your first kill! The audience demands you pretend to feel something.
Squeegee Salvation
Kill 10 slimes.
Achievement: 'Squeegee Salvation'. Ten slimes. The sewer sends a fruit basket.
Fashionably Dead
Die for the first time.
Achievement: 'Fashionably Dead'. You are late to your own funeral. How chic.
Serial Victim
Die three times.
Achievement: 'Serial Victim'. Three deaths! At this point we should just name a monster after you.
Unlicensed Pyrotechnician
Set an enemy alight.
Achievement: 'Unlicensed Pyrotechnician'. The fire marshal is watching. The fire marshal is also on fire.
Gravity Is Merely A Suggestion
Visit the Zero-G Ballroom.
Achievement: 'Gravity Is Merely A Suggestion'. Excellent. Your lunch is also floating. Don't look.
Soggy Bottom Boy
Swim in the Gutter.
Achievement: 'Soggy Bottom Boy'. You are wet. We hope that is water.
Loot Goblin
Open 5 crates.
Achievement: 'Loot Goblin'. Five crates. Your inner gremlin is smiling. It has too many teeth.
Crate Expectations
Open a gold crate.
Achievement: 'Crate Expectations'. Gold! Yes, there was a pun. No, we will not apologise.
Goose Whisperer
Get Admiral Honk to bite five enemies.
Achievement: 'Goose Whisperer'. Admiral Honk respects you. He will still bite you. Respect is not safety.
Read The Fine Print
Find a secret.
Achievement: 'Read The Fine Print'. Nobody reads the fine print. You read the walls. Weird. Good.
Hoarder (Level: Dragon)
Carry 18 different item stacks.
Achievement: 'Hoarder (Level: Dragon)'. Your bag is full of other people's property. How very capitalist.
Retail Therapy
Buy something from the Vending Machine.
Achievement: 'Retail Therapy'. You bought a thing! Capitalism: the real boss of every floor.
Hostile Takeover
Defeat the Floor Manager.
Achievement: 'Hostile Takeover'. You have fired your manager. In the most literal way. Corporate would like a word. Many words. Mostly screaming.
Pacifist-ish
Finish the Hall of Mild Peril having killed no more than 2 enemies.
Achievement: 'Pacifist-ish'. You ran past all of them. The audience is shocked. The monsters are offended.
Overkill (Probably)
Deal a killing blow far beyond what was needed.
Achievement: 'Overkill (Probably)'. That enemy was dead three times over. Would you like a medal? Here is a medal. It is a button.
Rolling Stone
Survive the boulder trap in the Hall.
Achievement: 'Rolling Stone'. The boulder missed you. It will tell its friends. It has a lot of friends. They are all boulders.
Mildly Hurried
Clear the floor in under 20 minutes.
Achievement: 'Mildly Hurried'. Under twenty minutes! The management feels slightly rushed. It is flattering.
FLOOR 1 COMPLETE
Floor 2 is under construction by a team of extremely motivated goblins.
Floor One survived! The next floor is called 'THE SMALLER BASEMENT'. It has fewer exits and more feelings.
